title: Recepcionista
description:
Sobre Nós

Você quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil?

Nós do Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes, estamos presente no mercado há mais de 39 anos e somos uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do país.

Com unidades em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 20 marcas e conta com a colaboração de 2000 profissionais dedicados e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil.

Estamos empenhados em garantir um atendimento rápido em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados, por um valor justo e acessível. Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que um atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que têm contato conosco.

É importante ressaltar que sua participação nos processos seletivos do Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é gratuita, e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores relacionados a candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um profissional responsável pelo agendamento de visitas e consultas.

Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:


• Realizar atendimento presencial e fornecer informações sobre procedimentos;


• Registrar os dados dos pacientes no sistema e atualizar cadastros;


• Controlar rigorosamente datas e horários agendados, buscando confirmação antecipada dos pacientes e informações sobre o procedimento a ser realizado;


• Orientar os pacientes sobre os procedimentos iniciais, encaminhando-os até o consultório;


• Cuidar da sinalização dos locais de atendimento, banheiro e copa;


• Organizar e preparar o ambiente de trabalho antes da abertura da clínica, mantendo-o limpo e agradável;


• Buscar alternativas de remanejamento de consultas, realizando encaixes e ajustes de emergências, estabelecendo prioridades e comunicando todas as partes envolvidas;


• Controlar o estoque de suprimentos e providenciar a compra de itens de escritório, higiene, limpeza e copa, realizando o abastecimento dos insumos quando necessário;


• Receber e separar correspondências internas e externas, como encomendas, telegramas, fax e correspondências bancárias, organizando-as e distribuindo-as aos destinatários, além de arquivá-las de acordo com a classificação de assuntos;


• Controlar e organizar os pagamentos dos pacientes, atualizando os prontuários após cada consulta e providenciando atestados médicos, recibos, cartão de retorno, entre outros, quando solicitado.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil, venha fazer parte do nosso time

title: Electro Technical Officer
description:

title: Social Investment Senior Advisor
description:
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group:

Corporate Relations

Worker Type:

Regular

Job Description:

What's the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil's Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment.
You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you'll be doing

As the Social Investment Senior Advisor, your main priorities will include:

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell's Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities

  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy

  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes

  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets

  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners

  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes

  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders

  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities

  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others

  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient

  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed

  • Ensuring compliance with Shell's business principles, ethics, and compliance standards

  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell's global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than the current employer.

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field

  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development

  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes

  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders

  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships

  • Experience managing external delivery partners

  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts

  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems

  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement

  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority

  • Ability to uphold high-quality standards, anticipate and manage risks

  • Excellent project/programme management skills

  • Solid team leadership skills

  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes

  • Maximise performance – Integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You'll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You'll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.

  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.

  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.

  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.

  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.

  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.

  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.

  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.

  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.

  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world's most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here .

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell's strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net-zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

For Both Roles

Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization
A desire to shape and elevate UX within a global enterprise organization

title: Academic Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Job Purpose
The UBMS Program Coordinator fosters a learning environment that encompasses academic achievement and college preparation that centers around STEM related fields. The coordinator promotes the vision and skill level for successful graduation at the secondary level and success with college matriculation and post-secondary completion.
Supervisory Authority
The Program Coordinator will supervise approximately 3-12 wage employees to include tutors, teachers, and counselors.
Nature And Scope
The Program Coordinator is responsible for facilitating the planning, implementation, and evaluation of the various components of the Upward Bound Mathematics and Science (UBMS) program which falls under the TRIO Programs with the Department of Education. The UBMS program is designed to strengthen the math and science skills of participating students. The goal of the program is to help students recognize and develop their potential to excel in science, technology and mathematics to encourage them to pursue postsecondary degrees in STEM disciplines. The Upward Bound Math and Science program at Howard University serves 52 students from selected schools in DC and Prince George's County in grades 9 through 12. TRIO Programs are located within the School of Education and the Program Coordinator for Upward Bound Mathematics and Science reports directly to the Director of the UBMS Program. This is a grant position that is fully funded until August 31,2027. The grant can be renewed for 5-year intervals at the conclusion of the current grant period.
Principal Accountabilities
Coordinating with target high school staff in Washington, DC and Prince George's County to continually recruit and retain 52 program participants each year.
Assist in the identification, recruitment and selection of project participants;
Planning, coordinating, and implementing the program's services, including Saturday Academy sessions during the academic year and 6-week summer program for each cohort.
These services include: academic instruction and tutoring, SAT & ACT preparation, career exploration, financial literacy education, cultural enrichment, community service, assistance completing college admissions and financial aid applications, and on-campus residential programs;
Maintaining documentation of services in electronic database and participant files;
Assisting in the hiring, training, supervision, and evaluation of summer instructors, tutors and summer residential staff as well as student volunteers.
Engaging with other UBMS staff members to provide formative assessment and continuous improvement of program delivery.
Assisting Program Director with preparation and submission of evaluations and reports, including the Department of Education Annual Performance Report
Developing and nurturing partnerships with faculty and staff of Howard University and DCPS and PGCPS School districts to enhance the program's services.
Coordinate and supervise the monthly Saturday Academic Sessions and Summer Component activities.
Coordinate and supervise college counseling sessions throughout the academic year.
Track senior participants' college and scholarship applications submissions and provide assistance where needed.
Other duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
Knowledge and understanding of student development
Commitment to student growth
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to be creative and initiate positive impact
Ability to work individually and as a team member
Strong time management skills
Vibrant and Innovative
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, science, engineering, psychology, education, school counseling or another related field. Experience working with underserved youth population (ages Strong classroom management skills
Some evening and weekend hours required during the academic year, and extended hours during the summer component.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in education, social work, counseling or related fields
Knowledge of student development
Prior TRIO experience
Ability to effectively design math and science curriculum
Demonstrated ability to organize and conduct intensive science enrichment activities.
2 years or more experience working with youth

title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know Our Team
The Engineering department oversees all Agoda's ML and software related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase Agoda's business through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, ML driven solutions, queue systems and data monitoring tools. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company's culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the engineering team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the ML engineering squad, but also the reward. We work across structured and non-structured data at scale. For example, our current ML models process millions of images every day to try and enhance the experience that our users get from our app.
Why Agoda Engineering Team (ML role)?
Our engineering teams are at the intersection of business analytics, ml engineering, data warehousing and software engineering. Our job involves dealing with distributed systems, stream processing, ml modeling and computation at tens of PB Scale. We focus on software engineering related to data replication, storage, centralized computation, and Data API's. By providing our users with ML products/tools, shared frameworks, and ML services, we enable our company to validate strategic decisions, make smarter choices, and react to the fast-changing world. We are a small but passionate team with people from different nationalities working together on a single goal.
In this Role, you will get to:
Lead the team technically in improving scalability, stability, accuracy, speed and efficiency of our existing ML systems and processes. Build, administer and scale ML processing pipelines.
Be comfortable navigating the following technology stack: Python3, Scala Spark, scripting (Bash/Python), Hadoop, SQL, S3 etc.
Should be able to understand internals of ML models such as LightGBM, Random Forest, CNN, Regression models, etc
Design, build, test and deploy new libraries, frameworks or full systems for our core systems while keeping to the highest standards of testing and code quality.
Work with experienced engineers and product owners to identify and build tools to automate many large-scale data management / analysis tasks.
We believe in end-to-end ownership; this role will involve taking and building systems that enable us to deliver ML models to production at a scale.
What You'll need to Succeed:
Bachelor's degree in computer science /information systems/engineering/related field 6+ years of experience in software engineering with a minimum of 4+ years in ML
Expert in SQL, Python3, and JVM based programming language – ie, Java or Scala
Expert in software design/design patterns, functional programming and object-oriented programming.
Analytical problem-solving capabilities & experience. A strong engineering driven mindset will be required to succeed in this role.
It's great if you have:
Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystems and Big Data architecture and techologies
Experience working with Open-source products
Experience with Scala development
Working in an agile environment using test driven methodologies
Systems administration skills in Linux

Employee discount for accommodation globally
Global team of 90+ nationalities
40+ offices and 25+ countries

title: Dynamics 365 CE Technical Architect
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CE Technical Architect is a core team member of our client's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The architect will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CE solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline;
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM Certifications (2016, D365) & Power Platform Certifications are desirable;
  • Strong technical & functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM and Power Platform stack covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors;
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant and proven end to end implementation experience in Dynamics CRM configuration, customization, standard or customized workflows, dashboards, forms, views, integration, custom plugin development, report development;
  • Strong and proven experience in developing solutions that involve Power Platform (including Power Apps like Canvas, Model driven, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, etc.)
  • Detailed knowledge and understanding of all areas within Customer Engagement including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service & Field Services;
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions etc.;
  • Good understand of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons
  • Proven track record of leading technical team and successfully delivering a number of solutions for medium/ large customers, preferably across a number of business verticals (e.g. healthcare, finance, insurance etc.);
  • Proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients' needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution following effective design approach;
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery;
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and DevOps methodologies;
  • Adept at business requirement analysis, solution design, development, system verification and deployment strategies;
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation;
  • Experience in creation of demos, supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage;
  • Business process mapping, Fit Gap analysis, work package estimation, work breakdown structure, modelling and documentation experience;
  • Excellent understanding of Dynamics CRM DB Schema and Business Data Model including the customisation and development of Business Data Models for different solutions;
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, development management, release management, data migrations, cut-over planning and hyper care support;
  • Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps & CI/CD pipelines;
  • Knowledge and understanding of .NET framework including extensive experience writing ASP.NET and C# code (not just limited to plugins/custom workflows) is a plus;
  • Additional Technical Skills: PCF Component development, TypeScript, Unit Testing of TypeScript/JavaScript, Unit Testing of .Net Plugins, Core technical skills, i.e. use of git for source control.

Responsibilities

The Technical Architect will work to implement various modules of Dynamics CRM working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.

  • Organise, execute, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders, business analysts and consulting team;
  • Interface effectively with other members of the consulting team to arrive at best in class solution, and provide a sustainable and scalable solution architecture and application to meet client's requirements;
  • Deliver high quality business and software solutions & services to clients ensuring the implementation of best practices based on Microsoft Dynamics standards and supported configuration/ customizations;
  • Ensure completeness in meeting business requirements and take accountability for project deliverables including and not limited to project documentation, solution design, performance, reliability, testing features etc;
  • Deliver all consultancy and configuration work according to our project methodology, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully according to the SLA: on time and on budget;
  • Maximize usage of OOB features and provide technical design or develop/customize solution approach for identified gaps;
  • Contribute to activities as required including technical presales, building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations;
  • Proactively skilling up on new versions and technology stack to be future ready;
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates;
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour; Be a trusted advisor for our clients and help to provide solutions which can be upgrade ready;
  • Proactively identify business/ project/ technical/ support risks and provide suggestions to mitigate or communicate as necessary;
  • Proactively communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally;
  • Support practice development activities such as defining, solutioning and configuring industry specific solutions;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice;
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings;
  • Drive for process improvement, feature reusability and other initiatives to maximize efficiency in delivery;
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team or supervisors;
  • Provide guidance and mentorship (technical/professional) to groom junior team members;
  • Represent our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times;
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times.

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That's why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, our clients, and our communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.

Don't worry, our client knows that relocation can be a challenge, which is why they have an extremely supportive onboarding team to help you throughout this process - They provide relocation support for you and your family. Our client is looking forward to meeting you and seeing you grow.

Responsável pelo primeiro contato do cliente interno com a T.I., apoiando o cliente interno ao prestar suporte técnico em tecnologia da informação nas áreas de infraestrutura e sistemas, para todas áreas informatizadas da instituição. 

Vem ser coragem

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Suporte em infraestrutura e softwares ao usuário presencial ou via acesso remoto;
  • Manutenção de computadores e periféricos;
  • Suporte em telefonia;

(obrigatório)

.

 R$ 2.000,00

Benefícios:.

 Café da Manhã/ Almoço / Lanche da tarde/Jantar no local;.

Vale Transporte;
.

Convênios com Instituições de Ensino;

100% Presencial

Etapas do processo

  1. Etapa 1: Cadastro
  2. Etapa 2: Entrevista com RH
  3. Etapa 3: Entrevista com Gestor
  4. Contratação

Quem somos

A São Carlos Saúde Oncológica é um hospital que construiu, ao longo das últimas cinco décadas, uma trajetória em saúde oncológica no Rio de Janeiro, com o objetivo de oferecer um tratamento oncológico próximo e personalizado. Desde a sua fundação, em 1967, passando por cada geração, até os dias atuais, todos procuram a São Carlos Saúde Oncológica com um único objetivo: o câncer. Nós já nascemos para cuidar do paciente oncológico.

Para isso, acreditamos no trabalho em equipe e investimos na composição de uma estrutura interdisciplinar em que o paciente e seus familiares encontram tudo o que precisam em um só lugar, 24h por dia. É o nosso conceito One Stop Care, que reúne Internação, Pronto Atendimento 24h, Quimioterapia, Radioterapia, bem como toda a parte de Medicina Nuclear (diagnóstica e terapêutica), Exames e Consultas com especialistas das mais diferentes áreas - todos voltados para a Oncologia.

Para nós, a vida vale muito. E por esse motivo, buscamos ressignificar o câncer e seu efeito nas vidas pessoas. Aqui, vamos além da doença e do tratamento em si. Encaramos o câncer de frente, como uma causa que precisa ser abordada sem tabu, sem medo e com muita coragem.

title: pessoa analista de comunicacao júnior
description:
AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE COMUNICACAO JÚNIOR - DESIGNER NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Os principais desafios como PESSOA ANALISTA DE COMUNICACAO JÚNIOR - DESIGNER são:

  • Apoiar na criação de peças digitais (e-mail marketing, apresentações, landing pages e outros materiais institucionais);
  • Desenvolver layouts alinhados ao manual das marcas e às diretrizes estratégicas da área;
  • Criação de KVs para campanhas e projetos;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para ganho de produtividade e geração de insights criativos;
  • Criar imagens, variações de peças e mockups com apoio de ferramentas de IA generativa;
  • Organizar e manter atualizada a biblioteca de assets visuais;
  • Colaborar com times de Comunicação e seus clientes na construção de campanhas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Conhecimento em Pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator e/ou InDesign), Canva e SharePoint;
  • Noções de design para comunicados e outras peças de Comunicação Interna, redes sociais e mídia digital;
  • Conhecimento básico de tipografia, hierarquia visual e teoria das cores;
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de IA generativa (ex: ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Firefly, etc.);

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Montreal - Barra da Tijuca

Jornada de trabalho: 40 horas semanais, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, com opção de flexibilidade das 8h às 17h.

Na YDUQS você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pai, mãe e irmãos (as). Permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;

  • Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;

  • Bem-estar e clube de vantagens com programa dedicado e vantagens exclusivas;

  • Oportunidades de crescimento, hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Horário Flexível, contamos com política de Horário Flexível para colaboradores administrativos do corporativo, com opções de jornada dentro das faixas definidas pela companhia, inclusive para o home office.

Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e, por isso, valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

DIVERSIDADE: A YDUQS valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós, por isso pedimos para que não deixe de responder.

Já pensou em transformar a sociedade por meio da educação? Então, vem pra Yduqs

A Yduqs é grupo de serviços em educação e tecnologia e temos o objetivo de promover um salto de qualidade para o ensino superior no Brasil. Oferecemos educação de qualidade para pessoas de todas as classes sociais, em todo o país, e ao longo de toda a sua vida adulta.

Com cerca de 1,4 milhão de alunos, somos um dos maiores grupos de educação superior no Brasil.

Com quase 16 mil colaboradores, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no país, de acordo com o Prêmio EXAME em Gestão de Pessoas 2024.

Somos embaixadores do Educa2030, movimento do Pacto Global da ONU no Brasil, e a única organização de ensino superior no mundo com classificação "AA" em rating ESG, concedida pela MSCI em outubro de 2023. Isso comprova nosso comprometimento com a educação superior no país e que estamos gerando valor para todas as partes interessadas em nosso negócio.

Educar para transformar.

Todos nós trabalhamos para o aluno, temos paixão por educar.

Cada esforço gera impacto real e sustentável.

colaboradores.

Para nós, educação e tecnologia são a fórmula da inclusão. A partir do que há de melhor em cada uma de nossas instituições, estamos criando, como nenhuma outra organização conseguiu, um ensino que combina qualidade, escala, amplo acesso, especialização e a integração entre o presencial e o digital.

O melhor ecossistema digital do setor

  • 80% das pessoas de inovação e tecnologia são internas
  • 150 parcerias com startups e soluções de inovação

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão, pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso.

Somos vidrados no engajamento das pessoas colaboradoras e implementamos um programa estruturado de eNPS, com 5 squads rodando em paralelo com foco em melhoria contínua na experiência do colaborador. Em 3 meses de lançamento já implementamos 14 melhorias focadas em oportunidade de carreira e infra digital.

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Sobre a vaga
A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Administrativo de Obra (Financeiro) para atuar em nossa obra, um projeto com alto volume de controle e exigência de detalhamento junto ao cliente. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), organizado(a) e com atenção aos detalhes, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos administrativos e financeiros da obra.
Principais atividades da função:
.Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;
.Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;
.Verificar se as retenções de impostos (PCC, IR, INSS) estão de acordo com o ensinado e devolver ao fornecedor quando houver divergências;
.Verificar o CNAE na nota fiscal do fornecedor, assegurando que esteja compatível com o serviço prestado;
.Conferir o endereço da obra nas notas fiscais, garantindo que esteja conforme o solicitado pelo cliente;

title: OCM Senior Analyst – Change, Learning, and Enablement
description:
What Success Looks Like In This Role
Provides consultation and hands‑on support to help leaders, teams, and organizations understand, adopt, and implement change initiatives. Supports the design and delivery of change, learning, and end‑user enablement activities that address resistance, improve adoption, and contribute to successful business outcomes. Focuses on the people side of change related to business process updates, systems and technology implementations, job role changes, and organizational adjustments, with an emphasis on end‑user readiness and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides change management, learning, and end‑user enablement support for defined initiatives and projects under the guidance of more senior practitioners.
  • Supports small to moderately complex change or enablement efforts, contributing to project workstreams as assigned.
  • Assists with change impact and readiness assessments to identify stakeholder needs, learning requirements, and end‑user impacts.
  • Helps identify process improvement opportunities by gathering input, documenting current‑state processes, and supporting future‑state recommendations.
  • Contributes to the identification of potential resistance, adoption risks, and capability gaps, and supports the development of mitigation strategies and enablement tactics.

  • Collaborates with change management team members, project teams, and stakeholders to develop and execute deliverables across:

  • Communications and messaging,

  • Sponsorship and leadership support,
  • Manager and team coaching materials,
  • Learning and training content,
  • End‑user enablement and support resources,

  • Resistance and adoption management activities.

  • Supports the design and delivery of learning assets (e.g., training sessions, job aids, guides, and performance support materials) that help end users adopt new processes, tools, and ways of working.

  • Assists in facilitating training sessions, workshops, or enablement activities as needed.
  • Provides support to project teams and people leaders by reinforcing change and adoption practices.
  • Helps track adoption, learning effectiveness, and change progress metrics; documents issues, risks, and feedback.
  • Monitors end‑user feedback and adoption trends, escalating concerns and improvement opportunities to senior team members.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives related to technology, process, or business transformation.
  • Exposure to learning design, training delivery, or end‑user enablement activities.
  • Working knowledge of change management and continuous improvement concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create client‑ready deliverables and presentations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with project teams, stakeholders, and change colleagues globally.
  • Willingness to learn and grow change, learning, and enablement skills through personal development and hands‑on project experiences.

Additional Qualifications

  • Prosci Change Management Practitioner certification, Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or related OCM certification is strongly preferred
  • Experience working across global, multi‑cultural environments is strongly preferred.
  • Multilingual communication skills are a plus
  • Prosci Train-the-Trainer Certification is a plus
  • PMP, Prince2, ITIL 4 or higher, Agile, Digital Transformation, Lean, Agile, Process Mapping and/or relevant instructional design and learning certifications are a plus

title: Senior Manager, Special Events
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world-class event experiences that elevate the tournament's global impact.
Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 special events. The role ensures seamless, high-quality delivery aligned with FIFA's brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.
Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament's international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, and multicultural environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery
Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of major tournament-related events, including but not limited to:
Oficial Dinner
Final Draw
Brand Launch
Mascot Launch
Team Workshop
Volunteers Kick-Off Event
Guest activities, when required
Coordination of Legends Matches
Participation in pre-match ceremonies
Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA's global positioning.
2. Creative Direction & Experience Design
Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup.
3. Operational & Logistical Oversight
Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.
Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.
4. Budget & Financial Management
Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.
5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination
Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
Manage protocol requirements and high-profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.
6. Team Leadership & Management
Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.
Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.
YOUR PROFILE
Education
A Master's degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
Additional executive education in large-scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.
Experience
Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
Proven experience leading high-profile, broadcast-level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega-events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.
Skills & Competencies
Strategic & Operational Excellence
Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.
Leadership & Team Management
Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast-paced environments.
Strong decision-making skills under pressure.
Financial & Commercial Acumen
Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost-control expertise.
Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.
Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage high-level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.
Personal Attributes
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
High integrity and alignment with FIFA's values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.
Requiriments
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito:
Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais:
Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo. Responsabilidades e Atribuições: Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo). Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais. Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão. Executar watchkeeping remoto, mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM. Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução. Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação. Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões. Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção. Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões. Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações. Manobras e Modos de Operação: Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP), decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão. Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação. 4Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética: Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e "quase acidentes"). Operar sob procedimentos de contingência: quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura. Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos). Registros e Evidências: Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes. Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução).

title: Analista de Marketing Pleno
description:
A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Sobre a área:

A área de Marketing BP Portfólio é estratégica para conectar as prioridades do negócio às necessidades dos consumidores por meio de campanhas, análises e iniciativas que fortalecem os produtos e a marca. Com foco nos lançamentos do catálogo, a área atua avaliando oportunidades, orientando as decisões de marketing e articulando ações integradas que ampliam o impacto e a relevância de cada produto no mercado. O trabalho envolve monitoramento de mercado, definição de direcionamentos estratégicos e colaboração contínua com equipes internas e parceiros externos, assegurando que cada lançamento seja conduzido com consistência, eficiência e visão de longo prazo.

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Acreditamos na intencionalidade para gerar movimentos transformadores, que reconheçam que diferentes grupos sociais partem de diferentes realidades que precisam ser levadas em consideração e acolhidas pelas pessoas e pelo negócio.

Equipes representativas trazem inovação inclusiva, nos permitindo criar experiências emocionantes para diferentes tipos de pessoas.

Queremos ser cada vez mais o lugar onde todas as pessoas se encontram e, por isso, essa vaga é para você, pessoa com deficiência, que quer crescer e construir o futuro com a gente, nos bastidores de produtos e serviços que impactam a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras todos os dias.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver briefings completos, estratégicos e estruturados, capazes de orientar equipes internas de criação, mídia, social e demais áreas de marketing. Isso inclui traduzir necessidades de negócio em objetivos de comunicação, definir públicos-alvo, proposta de valor, entregáveis esperados, prazos, indicadores de sucesso e alinhamento com a estratégia geral do produto;
  • Desenvolver os planos de marketing e comunicação dos produtos;
  • Acompanhar KPIs e métricas-chave das campanhas (awareness, performance, conversão, ROI), analisar dados e comportamentos do público, identificar aprendizados relevantes e propor otimizações contínuas. Transformar números em recomendações acionáveis, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas e aprimoramento das próximas iniciativas;
  • Pesquisar e analisar o mercado, comportamentos de consumidores, movimentações de mercado e tendências. Avaliar dados setoriais, benchmarking e insights externos para embasar estratégias, identificar lacunas e antecipar oportunidades que fortaleçam a atuação da marca e dos produtos;
  • Contribuir com a construção de estratégias de mídia multicanal — digital, social, offline e outros — garantindo o alinhamento com objetivos de negócio e público-alvo;
  • Atuar em parceria com áreas internas e parceiros externos para implementar ações de marketing que potencializem os objetivos estratégicos do negócio. Acompanhar entregas e cronogramas, facilitar alinhamentos e assegurar que todas as ações estejam conectadas a estratégia.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólido conhecimento em estratégias e planejamento de marketing;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados e métricas de desempenho (Google Analytics, dashboards, métricas de mídia, KPIs de campanha);
  • Conhecimentos em mídia digital e canais de comunicação (mídia paga, social, CRM, conteúdo);
  • Experiência prévia (entre 2–4 anos) em funções de marketing, preferencialmente atuando com campanhas, produtos ou projetos integrados;
  • Vivência na condução e acompanhamento de campanhas do início ao fim — briefing, execução e análise de resultados;
  • Experiência trabalhando em parceria com áreas internas, stakeholders e fornecedores externos (agências, produtoras, veículos etc.);
  • Histórico de gerar insights a partir de dados e propor otimizações ou novas abordagens estratégicas;
  • Pensamento Analítico e Orientado a Dados: capacidade de interpretar informações, identificar padrões, tirar conclusões e transformar dados em recomendações práticas e acionáveis;
  • Comunicação Clara e Assertiva: habilidade para transmitir ideias de forma objetiva e estruturada, seja em apresentações, conversas com stakeholders ou construção de briefings;
  • Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas, estruturar entregas e manter o controle sobre prazos e alinhamentos;

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

eficiência;

title: License Owner, Rio de Janeiro
description:
Passionate about soccer AND about business? Stranger Soccer is expanding to key cities around the world. We are looking for a License Owner to open and operate the Stranger Soccer business in Rio de Janeiro.

This is not your traditional management job - it is truly built for someone that wants to own and operate their own business (that happens to make the world's greatest sport accessible to everyone). This role is ideally suited for an adventurous and soccer-passionate entrepreneur.

Sounds Like You?

As a next step, please visit  and particularly the section Bring Stranger Soccer to your City to learn more about this dynamic opportunity. If it appears to be a fit, and you wish to learn more, please fill out the form there to officially express your interest. Be sure to download and explore the Stranger Soccer mobile app as well.

Responsibilities

  • Bring the Stranger Soccer brand and business to life for the assigned city
  • Recruit, train, and lead a small central team (2-3 persons) as well as a few freelance Official Hosts (game hosts) to kick off the operation
  • Identify and secure prime slots at football venues to run Stranger Soccer games
  • Engage in creative sales and marketing digital and hands-onto ensure that customers are introduced to the platform as a convenient and preferred way to play
  • Oversee a schedule of games, ensuring customers are delighted with each game they play, and keep coming back for more
  • Take advantage of the strong backing and direction of Singapore headquarters, where an operations and technology team is ready to support you.

You should have

  • A passion for soccer, and a strong connection to your local soccer scene
  • A business background, ideally in management and customer service
  • An entrepreneurial background or spirit
  • A commitment to owning, driving, and scaling the Stranger Soccer brand in the assigned market
  • A hunger to succeed: financial compensation for this role will be proportionate to hard work, business acumen, and effectiveness.

About Stranger Soccer

With 3.5 billion football enthusiasts in over 200 countries, football is the most popular sport in the world. But why don't more people play it? Stranger Soccer ) makes playing football as easy as going for a jog or to the gym. Browse dozens of games on its acclaimed Mobile App. Book a slot. Turn up and play.

Incorporated in 2017, Stranger Soccer has quickly transformed the sports & recreation scene in Singapore. In a few short years, it has grown to be the #1-way people play football and futsal in the country, amassing tens of thousands of registered users purchasing thousands of slots every week. Whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or anything else, the world now awaits.

Our Mission

To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.

Our Vision

A world in which playing football is as popular and widespread as watching football.

Got what it takes?

We encourage you to visit to learn more about this dynamic opportunity, and to express your interest. Be sure to download and explore the Stranger Soccer mobile app as well. We look forward to meeting you.

Gosta de ambientes estimulantes baseados na inovação? Desafio é o nosso lema.
Fazer parte do Grupo Pierre Fabre significa entrar numa empresa com uma história rica em valor, inovação e experiência com pacientes e consumidores. Uma empresa disposta a enfrentar os desafios do amanhã com você

Localidade: Barra da Tijuca/RJ

Apoiar no fechamento financeiro das vendas mensais;
Apoiar na geração do relatório de vendas diário;
Dar suporte na viabilização do pagamento das verbas comerciais, bem como monitorar a contabilização dos respectivos investimentos;
Suportar o time de vendas nos assuntos relacionados aos investimentos comerciais;
Apoiar a gerência na estruturação de análises financeiras (Volume to Value; Gross Profit; P&L Clientes; Tabelas de Preços).

Quem nós somos
O Grupo Pierre Fabre tem mais de 60 anos de experiência farmacêutica e foi inventor da dermocosmética. Temos orgulho em ser:
O segundo maior laboratório de dermocosméticos do mundo.
O segundo maior grupo farmacêutico privado francês.
Comprometidos em fazer produtos com Conscious Care: priorizando a eficácia, segurança e naturalidade nas fórmulas.

No Brasil, somos mais de 450 colaboradores distribuídos por todo o país. Somos conhecidos pelas nossas três marcas de consumo: Eau Thermale Avène, Darrow e Ducray. Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos entre os melhores empregadores do mundo, pela revista Forbes, e como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar, pela GPTW.
O Grupo Pierre Fabre é, antes de tudo, uma aventura humana. Cada colaborador partilha os mesmos valores, humanistas e autênticos, são esses:
ABRAÇAR A CAUSA do Grupo, aplicando e reforçando sua estratégia.
Buscar por sua melhor PERFORMANCE.

CRESCER A CADA DIA, sempre aprendendo ou desenvolvendo sua equipe.
INOVAR, trazendo soluções criativas em benefício de nossos clientes.
Construir objetivos AMBICIOSO e superar resultados.
Oferecer FEEDBACK construtivo para o sucesso coletivo da equipe e da empresa.
Ao se candidatar a esta vaga você está ciente que será necessário o fornecimento de algumas informações pessoais a seu respeito ("dados pessoais") à empresa para possibilitar sua identificação no processo seletivo, bem como para que a referida empresa possa entrar em contato com você.

Caso você seja contratado, estes dados poderão ser armazenados por um período maior em decorrência da elaboração e execução do contrato de trabalho.
Para maiores informações sobre como é feito o tratamento de seus dados PESSOAIS, bem como seus direitos enquanto titular de dados, você pode enviar uma solicitação ao Encarregado, da Pierre Fabre.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/she shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Term of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.
Work LocationBelo Horizonte, Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient, and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Provide technical advice and support the execution of technical activities related to ongoing and new projects. b) Evaluate slope stabilization, retaining structures, and drainage projects. c) Supervise consultants for projects evaluation. d) Provide managerial support and coordinate the overall implementation of the project's work programme, including development, approval, and implementation of activities. e) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, and private sectors, under supervision. f) Perform technical, administrative, and management activities to ensure that projects meet the objectives in terms of deadlines, budget, and quality. g) Provide appropriate technical support to implement activities related to the following areas: i. Capacity building and development. ii. Collection, production, analysis and management of data, information, and urban indicators. iii. Public policies. iv. Strategic and project planning, monitoring, and implementation. v. SDGs for localization and implementation of the New Urban Agenda. vi. Social mobilization and participation. vii. Effective advocacy, monitoring, and partnership. h) Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with headquarters divisions. i) Conduct technical activities to ensure that projects meet deadlines and quality objectives. j) Inputs for the identification and mitigation of projects' risks, including relevant challenges or omissions and other situations that may affect the development and implementation of projects. k) Attend meetings and conferences promoted by UN-Habitat partners. l) Document expert group meetings, forums, consultations, training events, and other activities related to the planning, development, and implementation of ongoing and new projects. m) Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n) Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. o) Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Civil Engineer (Urban Infrastructures) will provide technical advice and support the execution of activities related to the project. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Geotechnical Engineering (Slope Stabilization and Retaining Structures) or Sanitary Engineering is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related fields is required. Work experience:
A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience on urban related themes in Brazil is required.
Experience in drainage or slope containment projects is required.
Experience in nature-based solutions for drainage or slope containment projects is required.
Experience in sustainable urbanization for informal settlements is required.
Experience in project/programme management is required.
Experience in social housing policies, plans, and projects is desirable.
Experience in earthmoving, geometric and pavement projects is desirable.
Experience in budget for urban infrastructure projects is desirable.
Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
Good computer skills in Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook, and Web search engines are required.
Good handling of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is desirable.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.
Additional InformationTravel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3. UNOPS Salary Scale. Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted into the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. title: Supervisor de GSE
description:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob condições de clima adversas

Na Swissport, acreditamos na diversidade, na igualdade de oportunidades e no poder de nossos valores para impulsionar nosso sucesso. Como é ser um Líder de Equipe de Consultores Comerciais Internos? 


Você será responsável pelo time de agentes digitais que possui como missão atuar de forma estratégica para construção do relacionamento com o cliente, a fim de reter, rentabilizar e impulsionar o empreendimento da sua carteira. Além disso, entre as suas atribuições estão: 

  • Desenvolver planos de ação a fim de criar estratégias para rentabilizar as carteiras de clientes (aumentando as vendas e reduzindo o Churn)
  • Análise de métricas de sucesso operacional e melhoria contínua.
  • Analisar e estudar tendências de mercado e concorrentes
  • Treinar e desenvolver o time de agentes para garantir que tenham as habilidades necessárias para o alcance dos resultados esperados.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter, no mínimo, 1 ano de experiência em cargo de liderança/supervisão;
  • Ter, no mínimo, 1 ano na área comercial;
  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo; 
  • Comunicação clara e efetiva;
  • Foco em resultados, priorizando o alcance das metas.
  • Capacidade analítica, interpretação de dados, transformando insights em ações.
  •  Identificar oportunidades e problemas antes de eles se manifestarem, busca soluções inovadoras para superar desafios e gerar valor.

Escala e modelo de trabalho:


5x2 - segunda à sexta de 08h às 17h | Híbrido - Escritório Passeio, Rio de Janeiro

Etapas do processo: 


Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte

Entrevistas com o time de Recrutamento: Você terá um papo inicial com o time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de nos conhecermos melhor.

Entrevistas com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. 

Entrevista com o gestor: Esse é o momento de nos aprofundarmos na sua trajetória e compreender melhor o seu alinhamento com a nossa companhia.

*Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

title: assistente administrativo
description:
Na Leve Saúde, acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além da assistência — é sobre acolher, evoluir e transformar vidas com leveza e propósito. Somos uma healthtech em expansão, uma empresa jovem guiada por uma cultura colaborativa, inovadora e orientada a resultados. Valorizamos pessoas que buscam aprender continuamente, que têm brilho nos olhos e vontade de fazer parte de um time que cresce junto.
Buscamos um Assistente Administrativo para atuar na nossa área comercial, apoiando a gestão nos processos de planejamento, controle e análise de performance.
Esse profissional será responsável por estruturar e atualizar relatórios estratégicos, acompanhar indicadores de vendas e produtividade, além de contribuir com análises e projeções que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a eficiência operacional da área.
Procuramos alguém com perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados, que tenha interesse em crescer e se desenvolver em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante evolução.

Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente que incentiva o aprendizado, valoriza a troca entre equipes e reconhece o protagonismo de quem faz a diferença todos os dias. Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que acredita que resultados e leveza podem caminhar juntos, seu lugar é aqui.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar o planejamento e controle das metas comerciais, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho, margens e rentabilidade;
Elaborar, atualizar e analisar relatórios de performance comercial, garantindo precisão e clareza nas informações;
Consolidar resultados e gerar insights sobre comportamento de clientes, produtos e canais, apoiando decisões estratégicas;
Apoiar a liderança na construção de planos e projeções comerciais, contribuindo para o direcionamento das ações de vendas e crescimento;
Manter atualizadas as bases de dados e dashboards, assegurando consistência, integridade e atualização contínua das informações;
Apoiar a elaboração de apresentações e materiais de gestão para reuniões de performance e planejamento;

Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo dos processos administrativos e comerciais, sugerindo melhorias baseadas em dados;
Acompanhar o cumprimento de cronogramas, rotinas e entregas da área, garantindo eficiência e qualidade nas execuções.

Perfil analítico e raciocínio lógico, com capacidade de transformar dados em insights claros e acionáveis;
Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em parceria com áreas como Marketing, Operações e Tecnologia;

Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade para lidar com múltiplas demandas e prazos simultâneos;

description:
